description: Defines the BubbleNode class for representing bubble items within a rich text editor, including serialization, DOM conversion, and rendering logic.

classes.name: BubbleNode
classes.description: A class extending DecoratorBlockNode that represents a bubble item node with serialization and DOM conversion capabilities.

methods.name: getType
methods.description: Returns the node type as a string ('snbubble').

methods.name: clone
methods.description: Creates a new BubbleNode instance by cloning the provided node.

methods.name: importJSON
methods.description: Creates a BubbleNode from its serialized JSON representation.

methods.name: exportJSON
methods.description: Serializes the BubbleNode into JSON format.

methods.name: importDOM
methods.description: Provides a DOM conversion map for importing DOM elements into BubbleNode.

methods.name: createDOM
methods.description: Creates the DOM element representing the BubbleNode.

methods.name: exportDOM
methods.description: Exports the BubbleNode to a DOM element for rendering.

methods.name: constructor
methods.description: Initializes a new BubbleNode with given id, optional format, and key.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the unique identifier of the BubbleNode.

methods.name: getTextContent
methods.description: Returns the text content of the BubbleNode for display.

methods.name: decorate
methods.description: Returns a JSX element rendering the BubbleNode via BubbleComponent.
